Lina (Head of Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Putting a short live thread for clarifications on release cadence, oncall rotation experiments, quality gates, and SLA questions. Please keep replies short so we can action them.

Ravi (VP Eng): High-level: goal is predictable major release every 3 weeks, weekly minor/patch windows, and a documented fast-path for hotfixes.

Tara (Product): Product wants a one-sentence definition of "major" vs "minor" to stick in PR templates. Any suggestions?

Jo (SRE): Proposal: major = changes to API contract, model weights, or DB schema; minor = everything else (config, perf, infra). I'll add examples to the runbook.

Lina (Head of Eng): On oncall: several teams asked to shorten primary from 3w to 2w. Ops proposes a 2w primary + 1w overlap (shadow) where the outgoing primary is reachable but not first pager. Pilot two teams for one quarter.

Jo (SRE): I'll produce a pilot schedule and a simple handover checklist: recent incidents, active rollouts, outstanding action items, and key runbook links.

Tara (Product): About quality bars: product concerned about noisy eval alerts. What thresholds should block a release?

Jo (SRE): Starting thresholds: golden-set relevance drop >4% relative OR hallucination increase >5% absolute OR 95p latency regress >10%. These are configurable per-model. Alerts go to model owner + release lead.

Ravi (VP Eng): If a release is blocked by evals, what's the SLA for owners to respond? Teams need clarity.

Jo (SRE): Recommended: acknowledge P1 block within 4 business hours; mitigation proposal within 24 hours. If unresolved in 48 hours, release lead + product + reliability make the final call.

infra-bot: Note: new oncall-overlap template published at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/oncall-overlap (automated message)

Lina (Head of Eng): Action items: @Jo to PR pilot schedule + handover checklist by EOW; @Tara to add major/minor wording for PR templates; @Ravi will coordinate hotfix fast-path details. We'll collect PRs and publish a one-page summary.

Ravi (VP Eng): Please drop edge cases here (multi-service migrations, large-scale data backfills) so we can add them to the runbook.

Lina (Head of Eng): Thanks all. Short thread; we'll close after PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
